infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Loqzen uses the camera to take a photo when you clock in or out and to attach photos to your daily report.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Loqzen lets you choose photos from your library to attach to your daily report.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Loqzen records your location only at the moment you clock in or out so your employer can confirm you are at the jobsite.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Loqzen uses Face ID so you can sign in quickly and securely.
